notes.title: WWA 3rd Anniversary
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Commanders! 

World War Armies turns 3, and we’re kicking things off with a 12-day giveaway event AND a special art contest! 🚀🔥

🗓 June 20 – July 1 
Each day we’ll drop a unique code on WWA Game Hub - [url="https://hub.wwa.online/updates"]https://hub.wwa.online/updates[/url] 
✅ Each code lasts 24 hours 
🎁 Redeem them for awesome rewards like avatars, lootboxes, in-game currency, and even shop discounts! 

The first code is already live! 
Redeem code here: [url="https://hub.wwa.online/redeem-coupon"]https://hub.wwa.online/redeem-coupon[/url]

🎨 WWA 3rd Anniversary Art Contest is Live! 🎨 

To celebrate 3 amazing years of World War Armies, we’re giving our community a chance to leave their mark — literally!

Submit your best WWA-themed avatar artwork and compete to have your design added to the game as an official avatar. Whether it’s a gritty commander, a bold symbol, or something uniquely your style — we want to see your vision of World War Armies! 

🖌 Theme: Anything WWA — commanders, factions, tactics, or wartime inspiration 
🏆 Grand Prize: Your avatar added to the game + exclusive in-game rewards 
📅 Deadline: 29th June 
📍 How to enter: All submissions and contest details are on our official Discord 

👉 Join here: [url="https://discord.gg/HvnpDzdZb6"]https://discord.gg/HvnpDzdZb6[/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333165/492a9e90b0493790c321428598ee1de402d275e1.png"][/img][/p]

1.35.1 update has started rolling out and will become available to everyone shortly!

There are 2 major new things:

- Mastery Jokers

- Friend list purge

Your friend list will remove deleted accounts every time you launch the game

notes.title: Treasure hunt
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

Have you seen our most recent post? You've had very different ideas about it, but here is the truth: it's a treasure hunt!

You must collect 3 pieces of the puzzle scattered across our socials (Discord, Facebook, Instagram, Youtube and Steam - yes, we consider Steam to be a social too!) 
Collaborate with the others, share the pieces you found!
This is not an easy task so help each other to get an exclusive time-limited reward just in time for a big release in WWA this month!

What is the treasure? Well, if you get all the pieces together and prove your knowledge of WW2, in a couple of weeks you'll see a top-secret event with a top-secret unique reward that you'd be able to show off to the rest of the players!

Good luck!

notes.title: SEA Region Network Issues
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

Especially those from the SEA region this time!

We are aware of the lag issues you've got to experience lately. We've spent quite a while investigating the potential causes and it almost drove us insane as there seemed to be no issue whatsoever.

Until we found out that [b]SEA-ME-WE 5[/b] cable that connects the SEA region to Middle East and Western Europe had been damaged, causing loss of roughly 60% of bandwidth.

WWA is a PvP game, so peer-to-peer connection is crucial. Any data loss causes both players to suffer in-game lags. As result, any time a player from the SEA region is matched against an "outside world" player, both of them might experience lags of different degrees.

We are analyzing the potential actions that could improve the situation given that cable repairs might take weeks and weeks. I hope to be able to share more details soon, but that's it as of now. We know your game experience is disrupted and we appreciate your patience with us!

notes.title: 1.28 Update + Balance Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

1.28 - one of the biggest and most important updates in the last months - is out!

[h1]The main features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]THE GENERALS ARE BACK![/b]

Head to the game settings and select your preferred General/Officer style!

[*] [b]WWA very first Season of Iron and Dust[/b]

Compete in the Seasonal Leaderboard to get unique rewards that will never be obtainable again!

[*] [b]A brand new Ranked game mode with no AI players and new MM system[/b]

[*] [b]2 new units and a mystery guest that will come into play a bit later![/b]

[*] [b]Legendary skins! [/b]

Those orange tickets finally have a purpose! Those don't only have a badass look, but also provide a tiny HP buff!

[*] [b]USSR (and Puma) units rebalancing[/b]

Scroll down to know more!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333165/3d1974769857b552723ffcd15f3ace1ff6fffae3.png[/img]

[b]Puma[/b]

[list]
[*] HP increased from 875 to 1100
[/list]
Puma feels perfect in terms of firepower, but it was too squishy to fully shine and utilize its speed when retreating

[b]T-27 MINI[/b]

[list]
[*] Armor penetration increased from 0 to 15
[*] Explosive armor penetration increased from 0 to 50
[/list]
Mini was quite good on paper, but struggled in combat when compared to Willys due to no armor pen. We will monitor this one and adjust again if needed.

[b]T-35[/b]

[list]
[*] Main cannon armor penetration increased from 160 to 200
[*] Secondary cannons armor penetration decreased from 200 to 160
[*] AoE radius increased from 0 to 5
[/list]
Overall it felt quite silly that the secondary cannons had better armor pen than the main one. We're also adding a small splash to stay on par with the rest of the heavies.

[b]BA-30 SKIER[/b]

[list]
[*] Bullet damage increased from 5 to 12
[*] HP decreased from 1700 to 1500
[/list]
Skier felt underwhelming compared to HMAG and other similar units. It will not be the best performing armored car, but should feel much better even despite the HP tradeoff.

[b]HT-130 BURNR[/b]

[list]
[*] Turret rotation speed increased from 15 to 60
[*] Armor penetration increased from 20 to 40
[/list]
Burnr is an anti-infantry unit and it felt weird when it felt weak against armored infantry. This should help it perform within the niche.

[b]KV-2[/b]

[list]
[*] Front armor reduced from 200 to 190
[*] Rear armor reduced from 185 to 175
[*] Upper armor reduced from 165 to 155
[*] Armor penetration reduced from 210 to 190
[*] Turret rotation speed reduced from 50 to 30
[*] AoE radius reduced from 5 to 3
[*] Movement acceleration reduced from 2.7 to 1.5
[/list]
KV-2 is a moving fortress that was sometimes a bit too much to fight against. The new numbers don't make it uplayable, but give opponents a chance.

[b]ISU-152 MKILL[/b]

[list]
[*] Horizintal spread increased from 2 to 6
[*] Vertical spread increased from 1 to 4
[/list]
Mkill is no sniper, folks, but the firepower remains!

notes.title: 1.25.2 hotfix!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

Ok, 1.25.1 didn't work the way we've expected!

We are reverting some changes and making some tweaks to bring the PC and Android versions back in shape. 
Update 1.25.2 is now available on Steam!

Balance notes:

[b]M18 Hellcat:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reload time reduced from 8.5 to 7 sec.
[*] Horizontal spread reduced from 9 to 8
[/list]

[i]Hellcat is a glass cannon. When the cannon is slow and not too accurate, we have a problem. This update should help Hellcat to shine again![/i]

[b]M41 Gorilla:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shot damage increased from 100 to 200
[*] Void zone damage increased from 10 to 20
[*] Void zone duration decreased from 6 to 3 sec.
[/list]

[i]Gorilla was supposed to rely on the void zone damage, but it turned out that the enemies rarely keep their units in the zone for the full duration. Bumping up both direct and indirect damaged should make M41 an obviously superior choice over Priest (according to its rarity)[/i]

[b]T25 "FOGGY"[/b]
[list]
[*] HP increased from 1600 to 2200
[*] Front armor increased from 130 to 150
[*] Hiring cooldown increased from 130 to 200 sec.
[/list]

[i]T25 is an overall good medium tank, however we feel like it should stand out a little bit more, being a Legendary unit. This buff does not make FOGGY the strongest unit around, but makes it more sustainable.[/i]

[b]M8 Grayhound:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main cannon reload time increased from 1.5 to 3 sec.
[*] HP reduced from 1200 to 900
[*] Front, back and top armor reduced from 90 to 80
[/list]

[i]Being an uncommon unit, Hound was overperforming just way too much, often matching or even exceeding light tanks. It would still be a viable choice matching USSR and German armored cars, but would not feel as OP.[/i]

[b]M4 Sherman:[/b]
[list]
[*] HP reduced from 2500 to 2000
[*] Front armor reduced from 170 to 130
[*] Back armor reduced from 140 to 130
[/list]

[i]As a rare medium tank Sherman outperformed most of the other mediums, making the alternatives quite redundant. This will make it be more in line with the rest of its class.[/i]

notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders! 

We know some of you are eager to get their hands on the PC version!
And before you do, there are a few important things we'd love to share ahead of the release:

First of all, we will start with Early Access that will not feature the cross-platform login. You will be able to play the full version of the game, but it will start as if you were a new player.

notes.title: Concept art for PC a classic World War Armies Map
notes.content:
After a long radio silence, the WWA HQ is happy to share news about the upcoming release on PC.

Today's briefing is about the first concept of the redesigned Coastline, a classic map familiar to all WWA commanders from the first days of its release on mobile platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333165/50e461b3886ef0ec9efcc1074e7b3382d54a1911.png[/img]

As early as the prototyping phase, this map served as a testing ground for core gameplay mechanics. It turned out to be so good that it made it to the release almost unchanged and even today holds the highest record for the number of matches played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333165/035dfe5353dc38794495cedebb569d38e2d73804.png[/img]

The compact size of the map provokes commanders to daring aggressive assaults, as there is nowhere to retreat to. Remember: "Coastline" is not a place for a chill! However, if you like fast and dynamic battles - you will definitely like it here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333165/b323d502b7cbcd33287dd6d5b12a9cee617767c2.png[/img]

Please note that this is just a concept, and the final version of the map may differ. In particular, the scale of the map on the concept was slightly reduced for easy viewing.

[b]Make sure you add World War Armies to your wishlist so you don't miss out on any interesting details.[/b]

[b][h3]Attention, strategists and history buffs![/h3][/b]
After one year from its thundering release on mobile platforms, bringing epic real-time battles to your fingertips, [b]World War Armies[/b] comes to PC! Join the game's Steam Community and prepare to rewrite history and lead your nation to victory in the largest conflict the world has ever seen.

[b][h3]What to expect from playing WWA on PC:[/h3][/b]
★ Classical RTS gameplay experience — protect and upgrade your HQ, capture and hold strategic points, collect resources, train versatile troops, and lead them to battle!

★ Three playable factions — USA, USSR, and Germany — each with its own signature game mechanics.

★ Wide range of available tactics — from brutal frontal assault to artillery duels, flanking, attrition, and diversions.

★ Improved and engaging tutorial system — to onboard new commanders quickly and let them lead their troops to glory.

★ Cross-play with mobile players — dominate the battlefield like never before and crush your enemy regardless of their gaming platform.

★ Awesome visuals — we aim to create the best-in-class graphics with meticulous attention to detail and stunning special effects!

★ Complete integration with Steam —to ensure the best gaming experience for our PC players.

Screenshots and videos currently showcase the game's current state on mobile devices. We will update them constantly on our way to the release. We listen carefully to our players' feedback. We are currently in the process of selecting gameplay features to improve and adapt for PC. Stay tuned for game news to be the first to learn about our decisions!

If you suddenly feel like offering us your idea for the PC version, you can do it in the special section of the Steam community tab.

Wishlist [b]World War Armies[/b] to stay updated on all the news and share the game news with your friends. Your support is what makes us tick!
